images.prompt: Reframe this existing Martin Eberhard cutout for a consistent paired historical explainer. Preserve the actual person's identity, face, age, hair, clothing and photorealism. Output one portrait-oriented 2:3 transparent PNG, with ONE WAIST-UP person centered, the TOP of head at 6% of image height, eyes around 23%, waist at bottom edge, shoulders occupying 85% of width. No legs. Remove all existing surrounding background, glow, black/grey haze and large side margins. Clean true transparent alpha outside the person, hair edges natural, no frame, no text, no new objects. This is a crop/reframe and background cleanup of the same person, not a new identity.
